translation:
And feeling the accumulation below the shoulder, it was swept away without remainder, which was a relief, and the throat was also released; but in the end I do not know what channel it was.

Twenty: For several tens of days, I only rubbed above the ears and the two temples, and it came up continuously, emerging without end; I think the accumulation of the flanks and ribs inside the cavity must all go up to the head. One day while rubbing, I suddenly felt the throat tight and narrow, as if about to hurt; I thought to rest a little and then rub again. When I felt the jaw and below the ear, there was accumulation, thick and large, filling it up; the momentum could not be stopped, but I judged that something this large could certainly not go up. Yet I rubbed with all my strength, and it actually changed to flat and went up; rubbing the forehead corners and the space between the brows as well, it dispersed.
